name: Kongming, Wayward Maven: On Enter, gain the Shifting Currents mastery
notes: A level-1 champion's own On Enter only fires from a real materialize/level-up event (established by the earlier lorraine-honed-operative-banish-draw investigation -- a static CardID patch does not fire triggers), so the level-up is reached the same way: 1 memory filler seeded pregame pays the level-0-to-1 champion's 1-memory level-up cost, and both players pass turn 1 to reach P1's own myMaterial MZMAYCHOOSE window. Shifting Currents (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php's GainShiftingCurrents()) is a myMastery zone card (CardID qh5mpkyl60) with a Direction property, initialized to NORTH -- asserted directly rather than via a computed read, since GetShiftingCurrents()/HasShiftingCurrents() just read this object back.

rulesClauses: On Enter: You gain the Shifting Currents mastery.
